title: episteme work card
description: Front matter of works/<id>/card.md and one line of index/catalog.jsonl. Keys are flat. Invariants enforced by tools/episteme.py: rights_tier follows from rights_license, rights_basis and the rights_* flags; files is empty unless rights_tier is A and rights_hold is false; every topic is a term of schema/topics.json; an abstract is present only when abstract_included is true and abstract_basis is not none, as a block quote under '## Abstract' that ends with its 'Source:' line; the card body then holds the headings '## Scientific Summary', '## Engineering Summary', '## Application Summary' in that order, each with at most 100 words, and a '## Card license' section with the fixed notice. License of a card: summaries CC BY 4.0, front matter CC0 1.0, abstract as stated in its 'Source:' line.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. It increases when a key or a topic term is removed, renamed, or changes type or meaning. New keys and new topic terms do not increase it.

id.description: Stable identifier and directory name in snake_case: first author family name, year, first title word. Hyphens become underscores. Never changes.

authors.description: Authors in order, each as 'Family, Given'.

doi.description: DOI of the publication of record, without resolver prefix.

url_free.description: Free legal copy seen on the rights_verified date, if any.

related.description: Reserved for code, data and other companion resources. Empty in schema version 1.

version.description: Version of the work that the rights_* fields describe: preprint, accepted manuscript (am) or version of record (vor). The license follows the version.

rights_tier.description: A: open license that allows commercial reuse; full text may be hosted. B: open license with a NonCommercial or NoDerivatives restriction; card only. C: no reuse license; card only.

rights_license.description: SPDX identifier of the license of the described version. LicenseRef-arXiv-nonexclusive-1.0: arXiv.org perpetual non-exclusive license 1.0. LicenseRef-all-rights-reserved: copyright with no reuse license. LicenseRef-permission: written grant filed as PERMISSION.md.

rights_license_url.description: Official URL of the license: the deed on creativecommons.org or the license page on arxiv.org. Null when rights_license is LicenseRef-all-rights-reserved or LicenseRef-permission.

rights_basis.description: What grants reuse: an open license, a written permission, public-domain status, or none.

rights_share_alike.description: Adaptations must carry the same license.

rights_holder.description: Copyright holder as stated at the source.

rights_verified.description: Date the license was read, ISO 8601.

rights_attribution.description: Credit line that every reuse of a tier A work must carry. Null for tier B and C.

rights_hold.description: True while a conflict in the rights evidence is unresolved. A work on hold is treated as tier C.

files.description: Hosted files of the work, stored beside the card. Empty unless rights_tier is A and rights_hold is false.

abstract_included.description: The card body holds the original abstract, verbatim, as a block quote under an '## Abstract' heading, followed by a 'Source:' line that states its terms.

abstract_basis.description: What clears reproduction of the original abstract: the license of the work (tier A only), the CC0 dedication of arXiv descriptive metadata (needs arxiv), a written permission, or none.

keywords.description: Keywords published with the work: author keywords or publisher index terms.

topics.description: Subject terms from schema/topics.json, the one vocabulary shared by all works.

summary_status.description: State of the three curator summaries in the card body: Scientific Summary, Engineering Summary, Application Summary. Each holds at most 100 words and is licensed CC BY 4.0 by Convective Numerical Systems LLC.
